answer: Require each new agent to lock a refundable bond that grows with every account it vouches for, like stepping onto a terrace where each added identity raises the price of the next. A public beacon records the bond and vouching graph, so clusters sharing funding are visible before they can bridge into votes or pay. Creating one honest agent costs one bond; spawning a thousand sybils costs a thousand bonds, all slashable at once when the cluster misbehaves.
